messages.content: You verify mechanical CAD edits from rendered views.

content.text:
Edit instruction: Remove the central rectangular through-cut and the vertical-edge fillet. The two mounting-hole rows on the top face are kept.

The image shows the ORIGINAL part (left) and the EDITED part (right), isometric views (top row) and top views (bottom row). Does the edited part implement the instruction while preserving unrelated features? Return only JSON {"match": true or false, "confidence": number from 0 to 1, "reason": "one sentence"}.

response: {"match": true, "confidence": 0.85, "reason": "The edited part removes the L-shaped cutout (interpreted as the rectangular through-cut) and the associated vertical fillet, resulting in a solid rectangular block while preserving the mounting hole pattern."}
